description: Two men stand before a stone manor doorway in open countryside. The man on the left, in a wide-brimmed hat and long brown leather coat, holds out both open palms. The man on the right, in a dark doublet with a white collar, scowls and presses a hand to his chest. Behind them, a large three-masted galleon with a full set of sails floats in a stormy grey sky above a small stone house and green fields. The painting is an oil-style scene with no visible text, frame or border.
